tasks.short: Maintain and apply current safety knowledge

steps.what: Find current policies, regulations and industrial-process documents through approved source and revision views in {DOCS}.
outputs: Current source documents with revision and scope

steps.what: Read the original current policies and regulations, resolve applicability and maintain substantive technical knowledge of actual industrial processes.
outputs: Engineer understanding and identified uncertainties

steps.what: Apply that knowledge to the actual industrial-process safety question through direct examination and discussion with process owners.
outputs: Actual application judgment and issues requiring further evidence

steps.what: Write and check the actual application rationale and source references in the existing safety working note {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual judgment and unresolved issues from s3
outputs: Checked final working note

steps.what: Save the exact checked safety working note in {DOCS}.
outputs: Saved working note

tasks.design: Configure approved-source and revision views in the existing document repository. Keep substantive learning, applicability decisions, actual process discussion and the real working note with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant current source documents are located manually across approved repositories.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document metadata and saved source views.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a rule applies to a particular process and how it changes safe practice.
tasks.human_edge: Connect written requirements to actual industrial conditions.

ambition.what: No automatic compliance decision or procedure change.

tasks.altitude: Less source navigation while substantive understanding stays with the engineer.

reach.task: Apply current requirements to an actual process

evidence.claim: Native source and revision views can reduce navigation without replacing engineering interpretation.

assumptions: Shares are conditional E1 active-work estimates, not measured baselines. The existing working note is included; no mandatory new learning report is invented.

Existing document owners maintain source, process scope and current revision. The engineer obtains actual source documents in s1, interprets them in s2 and produces actual process judgments in s3. Missing metadata requires manual retrieval, with no saving attributed to that fallback.

Native configuration comes first. No gain is assigned to existing automatic source updates, original-source reading, substantive new note content or the short save. The ordinary completed-note check supplies the requested save gate without an additional self-approval stage; edits invalidate it.
research_questions: Can the configured view retrieve the applicable current original sources without omitting exceptions?

already_counted.description: Original-source reading, interpretation, process application, factual note and save are retained.

incremental.description: Maintain approved source and revision views.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed working note checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20*(1-.65)=7 gross; less 1 upkeep gives 6. Zero when source navigation is already configured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Inspect the actual product, use conditions and available incident or test evidence to identify physical, chemical or other product hazards.
outputs: Engineer hazard observations and evidence gaps

steps.what: Find and read applicable approved product-safety procedures and original technical requirements in {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual hazards and product context from s1
outputs: Applicable original source material

steps.what: Determine and discuss procedures for detection, prevention and elimination of the actual product hazards, including feasibility, limits and required verification.
outputs: Engineer-authored proposed procedures and limitations

steps.what: Write the actual proposed detection, prevention and elimination procedures into the recommendation draft in {DOCS}, using native headings and source-reference fields.
inputs: Actual engineer-authored procedure choices from s3
outputs: Complete recommendation draft with limitations and verification needs

steps.what: Check and correct the complete final recommendation against original evidence, applicability, technical feasibility and the intended recipients.
inputs: Original product evidence and technical sources
outputs: Exact checked final recommendation and recipients

steps.what: Save the exact checked final recommendation in {DOCS}.
inputs: Exact final recommendation checked in s5
outputs: Saved final recommendation

steps.what: Send the exact checked recommendation to the designated internal product owner through {EMAIL}.
inputs: Unchanged final recommendation saved in s6
outputs: Actual delivered recommendation

tasks.design: Use native approved-source retrieval and recommendation headings/reference fields. The engineer examines real hazards, designs the substantive procedures, writes their new technical content and checks the final recommendation before separate save and send steps.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source navigation and repeated recommendation formatting surround substantive engineering work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document views and reusable controlled headings.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a proposed control actually addresses foreseeable physical or chemical hazards.
tasks.human_edge: Engineering judgment about control feasibility and residual risk.

ambition.what: No automatic control selection, implementation or product release.

tasks.altitude: Small reduction in navigation and presentation effort.

reach.learn: Trace each proposal to actual hazards and verification needs

evidence.claim: Native document views and template fields can reduce source navigation and formatting while procedure design stays human.

assumptions: Shares are E1 conditional work estimates, not measured baselines. Actual inspection, procedure design, written recommendation and delivery are all included. No additional approval report is invented.

The engineer produces actual hazard observations in s1 and actual procedure choices in s3. Source owners supply existing controlled documents and revisions; s2 retains reading. No machine invents hazard findings, procedure content or missing verification results.

Only repeated headings and source-reference placement are shortened in s4; new technical prose stays fully human. Try native features before code. Already configured navigation or formatting produces zero additional benefit.

Ordinary completed-version review in s5 supplies separate save and send gates without additional self-approval labour. Any substantive change requires another completed-version check. Product implementation and release require their existing separate authority and are not claimed as automated.
research_questions: Does the native template reduce only presentation effort while preserving all hazard-specific reasoning?

already_counted.description: Inspection, source reading, procedure design, substantive writing, final review, save and send remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain controlled source links and recommendation headings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed recommendation checked in s5
Unchanged final recommendation and recipient checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*.30 + 15*.15=6.75 gross; less 1 upkeep gives 5.75. Rounded down. Existing configured features give zero additional saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find the actual findings and supporting records from accident investigations, facilities inspections or environmental testing in the existing safety-record system {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual assigned investigation, inspection or test
outputs: Identified original findings and evidence packet

steps.what: Compare actual source identifiers, dates, locations and attachment references across the investigation, inspection or testing record packet in {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual original record packet from s1
outputs: Draft exact-field matches, gaps and conflicts with source links

steps.what: Review the substantive findings against original evidence, resolve flagged gaps with the actual investigators or inspectors and determine justified conclusions and limitations.
inputs: Original findings and evidence from s1
Draft matches and conflicts from s2
outputs: Engineer-reviewed findings, resolved facts and explicit unresolved issues

steps.what: Write the report of actual reviewed findings in {DOCS}, filling native source-reference and event fields from the checked records while writing the substantive conclusions personally.
inputs: Actual reviewed findings and limitations from s3
outputs: Complete report draft with evidence links and limitations

steps.what: Check and correct the complete report against the original accident, inspection or testing evidence, including privacy, limitations and the intended internal recipients.
outputs: Exact checked final report and recipient list

steps.what: Save the exact checked final findings report in {DOCS}.
inputs: Exact checked final report from s5
outputs: Saved findings report

steps.what: Send the exact final findings report to the checked internal recipients through {EMAIL}.
inputs: Unchanged final report saved in s6
outputs: Actual delivered findings report

tasks.design: Configure native safety-record retrieval and exact metadata comparison, then native report fields. The engineer reviews real evidence, resolves discrepancies and writes substantive findings. Final report review precedes its separate save and send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual packet navigation, repeated metadata matching and report field entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing record identifiers, source links and native comparison/template features.
tasks.still_hard: Causal conclusions, incomplete evidence and sensitive incident information.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a documented observation from an unsupported causal assertion.

ambition.what: No automatic accident finding, corrective action or regulatory submission.

tasks.altitude: Less clerical packet checking while findings remain accountable engineering work.

reach.learn: Separate literal source comparisons from substantive assessment

evidence.claim: Structured identifiers support exact-field comparisons and report fields without deciding the meaning of safety evidence.

assumptions: Shares are E1 conditional active-work estimates, not measured investigation baselines. Boundary is reporting/reviewing actual completed investigation, inspection or testing records; creating those source investigations is separate unchanged work and receives no saving here.

Actual source authors produce the observations, identifiers, dates, locations and attachments through their existing capture workflow. Their labour is unchanged. The focal engineer retrieves sources in s1, checks original meaning and captures resolved findings in s3. Missing or unstructured fields go to manual comparison and reduce the benefit.

s2 replaces an actual remaining manual literal comparison only. Already automatic matching has zero new saving. Native configuration is tested before custom code. s4 saves only repeated source fields and presentation; new conclusions and factual prose remain human work.

Ordinary completed-report review s5 supplies the requested save and send gates without extra approval labour; edits require rechecking. Internal delivery only is modelled. Any required external filing retains its own existing authority and is not included as an automatic action. No saving on short save/send runtime.
research_questions: Do exact-field comparisons flag every missing or conflicting source without treating matched fields as verified substantive findings?

already_counted.description: Residual retrieval, original evidence review, clarification, substantive report writing, final checks and delivery are retained.

incremental.description: Maintain comparison fields, report mappings and access tests.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed report checked in s5
Unchanged final report and recipient list checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*.35 + 15 + 20*.20 =24.25 gross; less 2 upkeep gives 22.25, rounded down. Zero if these clerical operations are already native runtime.

steps.what: Examine the actual product, foreseeable use and misuse conditions and existing incident or test evidence concerning potential health hazards or damage.
outputs: Actual observations and candidate misuse scenarios

steps.what: Find and read the original product specifications, approved safety information and relevant prior misuse findings in the product-document repository {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual product and candidate scenarios from s1
outputs: Applicable original technical evidence and gaps

steps.what: Evaluate potential health hazards or damage that could occur from each credible product-misuse scenario, considering exposure, uncertainty and limitations of the actual evidence.
inputs: Actual observations and scenarios from s1
outputs: Engineer evaluation, rationale and evidence gaps

steps.what: Write the actual misuse-hazard evaluation and rationale into the existing product-safety assessment draft {DOCS}.
inputs: Actual evaluation and limitations from s3
outputs: Complete assessment draft with source references

steps.what: Check and correct the complete final misuse-hazard assessment against actual product conditions and original evidence, retaining explicit unknowns.
inputs: Actual product observations and original evidence
outputs: Exact checked final assessment

steps.what: Save the exact checked final product-misuse hazard assessment in {DOCS}.
inputs: Exact completed assessment checked in s5
outputs: Saved actual product-safety assessment

tasks.design: Configure product and revision views for approved technical sources. Retain actual product examination, misuse-scenario reasoning, hazard evaluation and substantive assessment writing. Save the completed checked assessment separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Original product and safety documents require manual navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native product-linked document and revision views.
tasks.still_hard: Foreseeable misuse, uncertain exposure and severity of potential harm.
tasks.human_edge: Reason about actual use and evidence limits rather than treating retrieved examples as a complete hazard list.

ambition.what: No automatic safety certification or product release.

tasks.altitude: Modestly less source retrieval, unchanged evaluation responsibility.

reach.task: Evaluate misuse scenarios against actual product design

evidence.claim: Product-linked source views can shorten navigation while misuse and hazard judgments remain engineering work.

assumptions: Shares are conditional E1 active-work estimates, not measured baselines. Evaluation includes the existing assessment record; no additional report or product-release process is invented.

Product-document owners supply existing specifications, revision metadata and prior incident sources through unchanged work. The engineer obtains actual product observations in s1, reads original evidence in s2 and authors the actual evaluation in s3-s4. Missing sources require manual retrieval or explicit evidence gaps.

Try native views before any code. No benefit is assigned to already configured search, original-source interpretation, new factual assessment content or the short save. Ordinary final-assessment checking supplies the requested gate without extra self-approval labour. Any subsequent change invalidates that gate.
unknowns: Coverage of product and revision metadata
research_questions: Does product-linked retrieval reduce navigation without implying that retrieved misuse scenarios are exhaustive?

already_counted.description: Product examination, original-source reading, actual evaluation, assessment writing, final checking and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain product and revision source links.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed assessment checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*.30=4.5 gross; less .5 upkeep gives 4. Zero when source navigation is already configured.
